create.name: Ashley Nguyen
create.bio:
Ashley Nguyen is a yoga and meditation teacher, astrologer and Human Design guide based in Honolulu, Hawaii, who works under the name Awake In Wellness. Before turning to this work she spent more than ten years as a software engineer, latterly at Disney and LinkedIn, and she often speaks about leaving that career and what helped her make the change. She holds a 200-hour yoga teacher certification and also plays crystal singing bowls for sound baths.

Her approach pairs chart work with practices done in the body. In readings and coaching she uses a person's birth chart and Human Design as a shared language for their temperament and choices, while stressing that the chart is a lens rather than a verdict and that clients remain their own authority. Sessions open and close with a short meditation, and her longer coaching programme, aimed mainly at professionals weighing a career change, adds yoga, breath and somatic practice. In Honolulu she leads yin yoga and sound bath classes, yoga nidra evenings and community events, and she teaches online through one-to-one sessions, guided meditations for each moon sign and Human Design type, a podcast and her Insight Timer library.

courses.title: Body Mind Freedom coaching
courses.description: A five-month one-to-one programme of twelve hour-long Zoom sessions for professionals rethinking their path, mixing coaching with astrology and Human Design readings, yoga, meditation and somatic practice. Email and messaging support and personalised guided meditations are included.

courses.title: The Lunar Sprint
courses.description: A two-week one-to-one container that runs from a new moon to the following full moon, with four 75-minute sessions that go deep into the client's natal chart, transits and Human Design. Recordings, chart reports and meditations are kept in a shared folder.

courses.title: Awaken Clarity Session
courses.description: A single 75-minute session that combines intuitive coaching with an introductory look at the client's birth chart and Human Design, framed by an opening and closing meditation. The session is recorded for the client to keep.

courses.title: Wellness Guide for your Moon Sign
courses.description: A downloadable guide for each of the twelve moon signs, with a guided meditation of about seventeen minutes and a PDF of daily rituals, short somatic exercises, yoga poses and journal prompts suited to that sign.

courses.title: Human Design Guided Meditations
courses.description: A recorded meditation of around half an hour for each of the five Human Design energy types, meant as a felt, bodily introduction to the qualities of that type.

courses.title: Embodied Wellness For Your Human Design
courses.description: A five-day Insight Timer course with a short daily lesson for each Human Design type, covering how that type tends to use and restore energy and a simple breath or wind-down practice to try.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Ashley Nguyen on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations, yoga nidra and short talks on astrology and Human Design, some in Vietnamese as well as English. Free to listen to.

free_resources.title: Awake In Wellness podcast
free_resources.description: Her podcast, with guided meditations and yoga nidra alongside conversations about astrology, Human Design and self-awareness. Also on Apple Podcasts.
